# Test Fixtures

`4HHB.cif` is the retained Protein Data Bank mmCIF test structure for PDB entry 4HHB. It is used by `test_real_mmcif_residue_mapping_and_site_features` to exercise a real multi-residue mmCIF chain and residue mapping. The file is copied byte-for-byte from the retained local PDB fixture archive.
